orders.text:
CRMA No.3427 of 2019 (Short Term Bail Application)
in
CRLA No. 233 of 2019
With 
CRLA No. 230 of 2019
Hon’ble Alok Singh, J.
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Abhishek Verma, Advocate for the 
appellant/applicant.
Mr. V.K.Jemini, Deputy Advocate General, for 
the State.
Heard on short term bail application.
The applicant moves application for short term 
bail on the ground that he has only niece i.e. bhanji 
and her marriage is scheduled to be solemnized on 
21.11.2019. In the marriage, the applicant has to 
perform some matrimonial rituals. 
Learned counsel for the applicant would argue 
that the applicant has to perform certain rituals in the 
marriage, therefore, he may be granted short term bail. 
Having considered the matter, this court is of 
the view that short term bail application deserves to be 
allowed.
Short Term Bail application is allowed. Let the 
applicant Sohan Singh be released on short term bail 
for a period of 5 days i.e. 20.11.2019 to 25.11.2019, 
on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two 
reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the 
satisfaction of the Court concerned. It is made clear 
that one of the sureties should be of blood relation of 
the appellant/appellant. 
After completion of five days, the applicant will 
surrender before the Court concerned and information 
to this effect will be placed before this Court. 
Let the paper book be prepared and supplied to 
the learned counsel for the parties on payment of 
usual charges. 
List the appeals after two weeks. 
 
 (Ravindra Maithani,J.) (Alok Singh, J.) 08.11.2019
Kaushal

orders.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
HON’BLE JUSTICE MR. RAVINDRA MAITHANI
AND
THE HON’BLE JUSTICE MR. ALOK MAHRA
Criminal Appeal No. 233 of 2019
10th December, 2025
Sohan Singh ………Appellant
Versus
State of Uttarakhand ………..Respondent
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Mr. Abhishek Verma and Ms. Aishwarya Thapliyal, learned counsel for the 
appellant/applicant.
Ms. Manisha Rana Singh, learned Deputy A.G. for the State.
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
The instant appeal is preferred against the 
judgment and order dated 09.05.2019 passed by learned 
Sessions Judge/Special Judge, POCSO, Almora in S.S.T. No. 
01 of 2019 ‘State Vs. Suraj Pal and Others’, whereby the 
appellant has been convicted and sentenced for the offence 
punishable under Sections 307 r/w 34 and 376(2) I.P.C.
2. The appellant seeks bail during pendency of the 
appeal.
3. Heard learned counsel for the parties on the bail 
application and perused the record.
4. This is second bail application. The 1st bail 
application has been dismissed on merit by the Division 
Bench of this Court vide order dated 19.03.2020.
5. Upon consideration of the submissions advanced 
and on perusal of the record, this Court finds no ground to 
grant bail to the appellant at this stage.
6. Accordingly, the second bail application is rejected.
7. List the criminal appeal along with connected 
appeal for final hearing on 17.03.2025.
(Alok Mahra, J.) (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 10.12.2025 10.12.2025
Mamta
